document_api_meta.title: Get Creator Marketplace Advanced Search Filters
document_api_meta.env_desc: This API allows you to obtain the advanced filters available in Seller Search Creator Marketplace. Because we are constantly releasing new filters which are specific to each country or region, this API serves as a way for developers to retrieve the latest available search filters.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: options
request_body_param.desc: The filter option types to retrieve. If this field is omitted or empty, both `option_list` and `sorters` are returned as empty arrays.

request_body_param.name: ^option_type
request_body_param.desc:
Filter option type to retrieve. Possible values:
- `OPTION_VERTICAL_PRO`: Category Pro, a label for creators who regularly post about one product category and generated most of their sales in that category during the past 60 days.
- `OPTION_LANGUAGE`: Creator language.
- `OPTION_CREATOR_LEVEL`: Creator level based on GMV. The definition varies by country and is maintained by the TikTok Shop Creator team.
- `OPTION_SORTER`: Available creator-search sorting options, returned in `sorters`.
- `OPTION_BRAND`: Creator brand information. This value is not supported in DE, FR, IT, ES, IE, or JP.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^data
response_param.desc: The available Creator Marketplace search-filter values and sorting options.

response_param.name: ^^option_list
response_param.desc: Creator Marketplace Advanced Filter Option List. If we return an empty object, it means this filter is not currently supported by your account or region.

response_param.name: ^^^option_type
response_param.desc: The requested filter option type represented by this entry.

response_param.name: ^^^options
response_param.desc: The available values for this filter option type.

response_param.name: ^^^^option_children
response_param.desc: Children option detail list, used if the option has sub option choices

response_param.name: ^^sorters
response_param.desc: The available sorting options for Creator Marketplace search results.
